note: the whole structure a country's schools and universities form — the general term this unit's comparisons revolve around.

examples.de: Das deutsche Bildungssystem unterscheidet sich stark von anderen Ländern.
examples.en: The German education system differs greatly from other countries.

note: the political decisions that shape the Bildungssystem — "bildungspolitische Reformen".

examples.de: Die Bildungspolitik ist in Deutschland Sache der einzelnen Bundesländer.
examples.en: Education policy is the responsibility of the individual federal states in Germany.

note: "mehr Bildungsgerechtigkeit fordern" — the idea that a child's background shouldn't determine their educational outcomes.

examples.de: Kritiker fordern mehr Bildungsgerechtigkeit im deutschen System.
examples.en: Critics are calling for more educational equity in the German system.

note: broader than just education, but constantly invoked in this debate — everyone starting from a genuinely fair position.

examples.de: Chancengleichheit im Bildungssystem bleibt ein zentrales politisches Ziel.
examples.en: Equality of opportunity in the education system remains a key political goal.

note: the problem Bildungsgerechtigkeit and Chancengleichheit are meant to solve — often measured by outcomes linked to family income.

examples.de: Studien zeigen eine anhaltende Bildungsungleichheit nach sozialer Herkunft.
examples.en: Studies show persistent educational inequality based on social background.

note: the OECD's international comparison of 15-year-olds' skills — regularly makes headlines and shapes Bildungspolitik debates.

examples.de: Die letzte PISA-Studie sorgte für heftige Diskussionen.
examples.en: The latest PISA study caused heated discussions.

note: the general term; the PISA-Studie is the most famous specific example.

examples.de: Internationale Vergleichsstudien zeigen große Unterschiede zwischen den Ländern.
examples.en: International comparative studies show large differences between countries.

note: school that runs into the afternoon, often with meals and supervised activities — contrasted with the traditional Halbtagsschule.

examples.de: Immer mehr Schulen werden zu Ganztagsschulen umgebaut.
examples.en: More and more schools are being converted into all-day schools.

note: the traditional German model — school ends around lunchtime, once the norm nationwide.

examples.de: Früher war die Halbtagsschule in Deutschland der Standard.
examples.en: Half-day school used to be the standard in Germany.

note: "unter Notendruck stehen" — the stress students feel around grades, a frequent topic in education debates.

examples.de: Viele Schüler klagen über zu hohen Notendruck.
examples.en: Many students complain about excessive grade pressure.

note: the teacher stands at the front and the class listens — often contrasted critically with handlungsorientierter Unterricht.

examples.de: Kritiker sehen im Frontalunterricht ein veraltetes Modell.
examples.en: Critics see lecture-style teaching as an outdated model.

note: students learn by doing rather than just listening — often proposed as an alternative to Frontalunterricht.

examples.de: Handlungsorientierter Unterricht soll Schüler stärker einbeziehen.
examples.en: Action-oriented teaching is meant to involve students more actively.

note: "eine Privatschule besuchen" — the natural counterpart to die öffentliche Schule in comparative debates.

examples.de: Die Zahl der Privatschulen ist in den letzten Jahren gestiegen.
examples.en: The number of private schools has risen in recent years.

note: state-funded and free to attend — the default option most German students attend.

examples.de: Die meisten Kinder in Deutschland besuchen eine öffentliche Schule.
examples.en: Most children in Germany attend a public school.

note: usually plural — "die Bildungsausgaben erhöhen"; often compared as a percentage of GDP between countries.

examples.de: Die Bildungsausgaben sollen deutlich erhöht werden.
examples.en: Education spending is meant to be significantly increased.

note: "der Schulpflicht unterliegen" — legally required attendance, varying in length and enforcement between countries.

examples.de: In Deutschland gilt die Schulpflicht bis zum Alter von 18 Jahren.
examples.en: In Germany, compulsory schooling applies until the age of 18.

note: informal but standard: "er ist sitzengeblieben" — a distinctly German-system practice, not universal internationally.

examples.de: Wegen schlechter Noten musste sie sitzenbleiben.
examples.en: Because of bad grades she had to repeat the year.

note: "Nachhilfe nehmen/geben" — private, often paid, additional instruction outside regular school.

examples.de: Viele Eltern zahlen für Nachhilfe in Mathematik.
examples.en: Many parents pay for tutoring in mathematics.

note: "eine kleinere Klassengröße" — one of the most commonly cited factors in comparing school quality.

examples.de: Eine kleinere Klassengröße soll die Lernqualität verbessern.
examples.en: A smaller class size is meant to improve the quality of learning.

note: prestigious, highly selective institutions — a much bigger factor in some countries' systems than Germany's, where most universities are seen as roughly equal in standing.

examples.de: Anders als in den USA gibt es in Deutschland kein ausgeprägtes System von Eliteuniversitäten.
examples.en: Unlike in the US, Germany has no pronounced system of elite universities.

note: "der Bildungsstand der Bevölkerung" — often used in statistics comparing countries or social groups.

examples.de: Der Bildungsstand der Bevölkerung ist stark gestiegen.
examples.en: The population's level of education has risen sharply.

note: "den Lehrplan reformieren" — what's actually taught, which varies significantly between German states and other countries.

examples.de: Der Lehrplan wird alle paar Jahre überarbeitet.
examples.en: The curriculum is revised every few years.

note: the general umbrella term for any level of completed education — distinct from B1 Unit 8's specific "der ausländische Abschluss" for recognition purposes.

examples.de: Der höchste Bildungsabschluss variiert stark je nach Land.
examples.en: The highest level of educational qualification varies greatly by country.

note: education before formal schooling starts — increasingly seen as key to later Bildungsgerechtigkeit.

examples.de: Investitionen in frühkindliche Bildung gelten als besonders wirksam.
examples.en: Investment in early childhood education is seen as especially effective.

note: a specific instance of B2 Unit 11's "der Fachkräftemangel", applied to schools.

examples.de: Der Lehrermangel zwingt manche Schulen zu größeren Klassen.
examples.en: The teacher shortage forces some schools into larger class sizes.

note: ties directly to B2 Unit 15 — how far schools have modernised with digital tools, a common point of international comparison.

examples.de: Bei der Digitalisierung der Schulen liegt Deutschland international eher zurück.
examples.en: Germany lags behind internationally when it comes to school digitalisation.

note: close to "der Bildungsstand" but more often used for a country or system as a whole rather than an individual.

examples.de: Das allgemeine Bildungsniveau wird oft anhand der PISA-Studie verglichen.
examples.en: The general level of education is often compared using the PISA study.

german: zwei Blickwinkel auf Bildung: Navigation und Debatte
english: two angles on education: navigating the system vs. debating it
note: B1 Unit 8 gave you the vocabulary to navigate the German system as an international student — Anerkennung, Immatrikulation, ECTS. This unit gives you the vocabulary to discuss and compare education systems as a policy topic.

examples.de: Erst die Immatrikulation, dann die Diskussion über Bildungsgerechtigkeit.
examples.en: First the enrolment, then the debate about educational equity.
